nodes.title: 共享负面提示词 (FLUX 留空)
武学技能批量出图说明 (共16张)
widgets_values:
■ 工作流: 武学技能图标批量生成 (FLUX)
   一次 Queue Prompt 出全部 16 张
   预计耗时 85-100 分钟 (M4 Pro)

■ 武学序列 (方形构图无外框):
   剑法 1-4 sword_control/myriad_swords/
             cold_light_sword/thousand_mountain_snow
   拳掌 5-8 luohan_fist/fire_palm/
             water_qi/tiangang_qi
   身法 9-12 lingbo_steps/wind_riding/
              five_dun/bone_melt_palm
   修真 13-16 taiji_method/yuanying_method/
               zhoutian_dao/ascension

■ 风格一致性:
   - 共享 seed 88888888 (fixed)
   - 共享 EmptyLatent 1024x1024
   - 方形构图无外框 (与天赋/Buff 系明显不同)

■ 输出 (每张 2 份):
   output/wuxia_skill_1024/[name].png   (1024 母版)
   output/wuxia_skill_128/[name].png    (128 游戏图标)

■ 命名规范 (与 martial-arts-system 对齐):
   skill_icon_[name].png
   由 import_ai_assets.sh 自动回流到
   assets/ui/skill_icons/

■ 单张重抽: 同前

■ 注意:
   武学没外框, FLUX 偶尔会自己加一圈, 若出现可单抽
   提示词里已写 no outer border or ring 进行约束

nodes.title: 1. skill_icon_sword_control - 正面
widgets_values: A minimalist game UI martial arts skill icon for a cultivation wuxia RPG, centered square composition. Subject: a single flying sword hovering horizontally above swirling cloud wisps in the center, with a faint daoist seal rune pattern glowing beneath the sword. The subject occupies about 80 percent of the canvas in the center with bold confident presence, with minimal empty space, filling the square frame naturally without any outer border or ring. Pure clean solid white background, no other elements. Flat vector illustration style, painted with traditional Chinese ink wash brushstrokes but extremely simplified for icon use. silver white and pale jade cyan color palette only. No realistic human portraits, only stylized silhouettes if any, no facial features, no complex patterns, no maze patterns, no ornate frames, no text, no chinese characters, no multiple duplicates, no asymmetric debris. Single focal point on the central subject. Designed to be readable when scaled down to 64x64 pixels. Balanced confident composition. Highest quality concept art for game UI.
